text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"What's wrong, Tarumae? Is something 
bothering you?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... um, well... ...First off, happy 
birthday, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... if it's okay with you, would you 
let me treat you tonight? ...To surf clam 
rice."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned wanting to try it before, 
right? I even ordered some great Sakhalin 
surf clams from back home.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know if I did a good job, 
though. Or rather, I don't even know if 
home cooking makes for a good present...!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's surf clam rice made by the Tomakomai 
Tourism Ambassador, right? I'm sure you 
know the most delicious recipe, and 
besides, you're a great cook, Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, just thinking about it is making me 
hungry! Ehehe, I can't wait♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Jeez. Your face is way too loose...
